incidents.title: Authentication service cascade failure
incidents.description: Token validation service experienced memory leak under sustained load, causing cascading failures across payment and user services. All payment transactions failed for 15 minutes during peak traffic.
incidents.root_cause: Token validation service memory leak under load - JVM heap exhaustion when concurrent token refresh requests exceeded 500/s
incidents.resolution: Scaled token validation pods from 3 to 8, deployed emergency memory limit increase, scheduled permanent fix in next sprint
action_items: Implement circuit breaker for token validation
Add memory pressure alerting at 60% threshold
Load test token service to 2x peak capacity

incidents.title: Elevated error rates on notification-service
incidents.description: Notification service experienced intermittent SMTP connection failures causing elevated error rates and delayed message delivery.
incidents.root_cause: Upstream SMTP relay rate limiting triggered during morning notification batch
incidents.resolution: Implemented exponential backoff and retry logic for SMTP connections, distributed batch sends across wider time window
action_items: Implement dead letter queue for failed notifications

incidents.title: Intermittent database connection timeout
incidents.description: Application experienced sporadic database connection timeouts during connection pool exhaustion under moderate load.
incidents.root_cause: Connection pool max size (20) insufficient for traffic pattern; long-running queries holding connections
incidents.resolution: Increased connection pool to 50, added query timeout of 5s, identified and optimized 3 slow queries
action_items: Add slow query alerting at 2s threshold

incidents.title: Deployment rollback due to canary failure
incidents.description: Canary deployment of payment-service v2.14.1 detected elevated error rates and automatically rolled back. No user impact due to canary catching the issue.
incidents.root_cause: Configuration typo in new retry logic caused infinite retry loop on 4xx errors
incidents.resolution: Fixed configuration, added unit test for retry behavior, re-deployed successfully next day
action_items: Add config validation step to CI pipeline
